propositions: The Git version floor gate step hard-errors when .github/git-version-floor.txt is absent, but Gerrit runs workflow definitions from main while checking out patchset trees, causing every pre-gate change to fail despite having no git-version-related edits.

Changes branched before c433663721 merged receive the gate step from main but lack the floor file from their older patchset tree, producing false Verified -1 votes unrelated to actual git version floors.

The established repository pattern (ee2a convention) mandates if-present guards for gate steps reading repo artifacts, with two adjacent steps already implementing it, but the git-floor gate violates this invariant by hard-failing instead of skipping.

The absence of the floor file is the sole failure cause for affected changes (confirmed by runtime execution of the step against fixture trees with and without the file; the runner's git 2.55.0 is far above the 2.38 floor).
